verdict.rationale: Vue lists Pinia as an official store in its docs, and a community user notes Vue ships an official store (Vuex), so global state needs no third-party library. Vue's core also has a reactive system with an ergonomic state API. However, Pinia and Vuex are separate packages rather than core primitives, and nothing shows core reactivity being used for global shared state. Missing for 10: evidence that core primitives (e.g. reactive/ref) support global state without an extra package, in-depth state-management docs, and hands-on corroboration of a no-library global-state pattern.
